# App logos (Install tab)

`src/Tweaker/Resources/AppIcons/*.png` are the programs' own icons, resized to 128 px. They are trademarks of
their respective owners and are used only to identify each program in the Install list. No endorsement is implied.

Sources: the projects' own repositories (VS Code, WinDirStat, HandBrake, CrystalDiskInfo, Rufus, Bulk Crap
Uninstaller, BleachBit, VeraCrypt) and the icons published with their Chocolatey packages / the UniGetUI icon
database for the rest.
